name: BiteCurve: Fishing Forecast
subtitle: Solunar, Tide & Barometer Log
description:
Plan your time on the water around the conditions at your own spots.
BiteCurve calculates a 0 to 100 bite index and the best two hours of each day for the places you fish.
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your spots and trip log stay on your iPhone.

Whether you fish lakes, rivers or the coast, BiteCurve turns weather, water, moon and tide into one clear outlook. It is an estimate to help you decide when to go, not a promise of a catch.

HOW THE BITE INDEX WORKS
For every spot you place on the map, BiteCurve weighs:
• Light around sunrise and sunset
• Water temperature: satellite sea-surface readings on the coast, an estimate from recent weather inland, or your own reading
• Wind speed and direction, and which bank you fish from
• Barometric pressure trend, plus optional live barometer readings from your iPhone during a trip
• Moon position and phase
• Tide predictions from NOAA stations for saltwater spots along US coasts and territories, including spring and neap tides

FISH AND WATERS
Pick the water and the fish for each spot, or let the map show which fish the conditions suit right now:
• Largemouth bass, walleye, northern pike, rainbow trout
• Carp, crucian carp, perch, bream
• Sea bass, striped bass, red drum, cod, mackerel, sea trout, flounder
• Warm freshwater, cold freshwater, inshore saltwater

PLAN THE WEEK
• Planner: all your spots against the days ahead, with the best spot and day picked out
• Bite alerts: a notification an hour before a good window and the evening before a good day, worked out on your iPhone
• Home and Lock Screen widgets with your best spot and its window
• Share a forecast card with your fishing friends

TRIP LOG
• Log every outing, blank trips included, and tap once for each fish to record when it bit
• "Was the forecast right?" compares your catches with what the forecast said, in plain numbers
• Saved forecasts stay usable for about 10 days, so you can check conditions without signal

PRIVACY
Your exact pin never leaves your iPhone: only a coarse 5 km map cell is sent to fetch Apple Weather data. Catch sharing is off unless you switch it on. It sends anonymous trip statistics without the spot, its name or the date, and you can delete what you shared at any time.

INCLUDED WITHOUT A SUBSCRIPTION
• Up to 3 saved spots
• Today and tomorrow: bite index and best window
• Full trip log, forecast check, widgets and bite alerts

BITECURVE PRO
BiteCurve Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription available on a yearly or monthly plan (the yearly plan includes a trial period). Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and you can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple Account settings. BiteCurve Pro unlocks:
• Unlimited saved spots
• 10-day outlook and the full planner
• Hourly bite curve and tide curve
• Expected catch scaled to your personal trip log

promotionalText: New: a week planner across all your spots, bite alerts before a good window, home screen widgets, sea fish and satellite water temperature.
whatsNew:
The biggest update yet: plan the week, not just the day.

• Planner: all your spots against the next days, with the best one picked out.
• Bite alerts: a notification an hour before a good window and the evening before a good day.
• Home and Lock Screen widgets.
• Sea fishing: sea bass, cod, mackerel, striped bass, red drum and more, with spring and neap tides.
• The map shows which fish the water suits right now. Carp, perch and bream are new.
• Water temperature from satellite readings on the coast.
• Tap once for each fish you land. The log then shows whether the forecast was right for you.
• Share a forecast card with friends.
• Optional, anonymous catch sharing to improve the forecast. Off unless you switch it on.
• Now in 17 more languages.
